column1: # Jujutsu (github.com/jj-vcs/jj) at 4351061bb, 456 Rust files. Fixed before the first run (2026-11-17).

column2: What does jj do on Windows when replacing a file fails because another process has the target file open?
How does jj detect that a Git remote uses a different object format (SHA-1 vs. SHA-256) than the local repository?
How can a user resolve a conflict by editing the conflict markers in their own text editor, and how does jj read the result back?
How does jj limit how many backend requests are in flight when it reads or writes many trees at once?
How does jj's diff output choose the source line, such as the enclosing function's signature, that it shows as context for a hunk?
